desc:
Welcome to T-Rex vs 99 Players! 🦖

🦖 THE T-REX: You’re a giant dinosaur. Chomp, stomp and tail-whip every human before the timer runs out!
🔫 THE HUMANS: Team up, open fire and take down the T-Rex but be carefull, it wants to EAT YOU!

⚡ Rounds are short and chaotic, with up to 40 humans against 1 T-Rex.
🪙 Use coins to open crates and unlock OP Guns!

👍 Enjoying the game?
Leave a thumbs-up, it helps a lot!
